{{Top}}
A '''liter''' was a fluid measurement. The [[Hadrassi Emergency Medical Systems Technologies]] [[PFG-700]] was capable of replicating up to two liters of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] substitute an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].
